p87_semantics.nearby_metadata_note: P89 has explicit b0/b1/b2 labels in the same Vitosoft-derived export, while P87 remains generically named. This supports treating the missing P87 bit map as genuinely unresolved in the available metadata.

external_context.source: Viessmann Climate Solutions Community, Viessmann Customer-Care response
external_context.statement: VSKO 61/189 correspond to E8: ionization current during a 10-second start phase is outside the valid range; VSKO code 5 is flame loss during stabilization time.

external_context.source: Vitodens 200 WB2A service instruction / ionization-current section
external_context.statement: Minimum ionization current is expected already when the flame forms, approximately 2-3 seconds after the gas combination valve opens.

p87_semantics.interpretation: The measured P87 bit-1 transition precedes P09 plateau release and occurs on the approximately 10-second post-start timescale. Combined with the service/VSKO context, this is more compatible with a marker/precursor near the end of a supervised start or stabilization interval than with first flame recognition.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not name P87 bit 1 as flame detected.
Do not name P87 bit 1 as flame stabilized.
Do not name P87 bit 1 as regulation enabled.
Do not claim P87 bit 1 causes P09 plateau release.

findings: The splitter can initialize permanently as VS1/KW when settings.vs1protocol is true.
Normal read/write datapoint APIs map to VS1 F7 Virtual_READ and F4 Virtual_WRITE in that mode.
The main loop serializes poll-list, MQTT, and TCP work through one Optolink serial owner.
VS1 keepalive uses a Virtual_READ of 0x00F8 when idle for roughly 0.5 seconds.
Function-code metadata knows GFA_READ 0x6B, but the structured generic request path raises NotImplementedError in VS1 mode.
optolinkvs1.py currently exposes structured Virtual_READ/Virtual_WRITE only; no structured GFA_READ helper is present.
upstream_integration_analysis.production_direction: If hardware compatibility is confirmed, prefer one permanent VS1 serial owner and add a narrow structured GFA_READ path to the splitter rather than repeatedly switching P300<->VS1 or running a second direct-serial process.
upstream_integration_analysis.updater_constraint: The local updater hard-resets /opt/optolink to upstream origin/main. Any local production patch must therefore be reapplied/pinned atomically by the installer/updater or be accepted upstream.

pass_criteria: Every stable value exactly matches P300 baseline, VS1 F7, and P300 post-check.
Two same-session P80 guards both equal 0x20.
P300 post-check and service restoration succeed.
next_hardware_probe.test_note: Published helper embeds 8 new frame/allowlist tests and recursively runs 23 pinned P80 tests. The runtime logic was additionally exercised pre-publication with 8 build-harness mixed-session integration scenarios.
